data.content_ref: inline:The target's claim that the sustained flags are an artifact of design rather than an empirical finding is unsupported by any premise or evidence. It asserts a structural inevitability ('the harness will inevitably confirm consistency') without quoting or referencing any part of the adjudication ritual or critic schema to substantiate that the ritual is itself falsificationist. Because the problem context asks for an audit of adjudication-ritual flags sustained (§11.3), the target must anchor its claim in the cited standard; instead it offers a bare assertion about the harness's design, which is not self-evident from the given context.
